theme.designMd:
# Folio reading tracker (code.in.30s)
Minimal monochrome book reading tracker mobile app for students. Near-black ink #141414, off-white #F5F4F0, grey #8A8A8A secondary text, ONE bold accent orange #E8742A (progress bars, streak flame, active nav, primary button). Tiny yellow #F5C518 stars only for ratings. Geometric sans: heavy 800 titles, small regular body. Fully rounded pill buttons and chips, 10px radius book covers and tiles, hairline borders, NO heavy shadows, no gradients. Book covers are flat graphic/typographic designs (big type, simple shapes) with invented titles. No photos of people except simple initials avatars.
## Light: background off-white #F5F4F0, cards white #FFFFFF with #E7E5DF border, ink #141414, muted #8A8A8A, accent #E8742A.

outputComponents.text:
I've designed the **Light Mode** Home screen for **Folio**, following your visual identity and design specs:

### Key Design Details:
- **Palette & Contrast:** Crisp off-white (`#F5F4F0`) background with clean white (`#FFFFFF`) card surfaces and 1px hairline borders (`#E7E5DF`). Ink is near-black (`#141414`) paired with muted slate grey (`#8A8A8A`) and the signature vibrant accent orange (`#E8742A`).
- **Typography & Geometry:** Heavy geometric 800 titles, clean sans body text, rounded pill badges and buttons, and strictly 10px corner radius on book covers and thumbnail tiles without heavy shadows or gradients.
- **Header:** Clean top bar with *Folio* monogram logo, notification bell, initial avatar `'R'`, and the personalized greeting *"Good evening, Riya"*.
- **Reading Streak Card:** 12-day streak header with orange flame badge, Level 3 indicator chip, and a 7-day row (Mon–Sun) with 5 filled orange checkmark dots.
- **Currently Reading:** Featured card showcasing the flat graphic typographic cover for **"Quiet Orbit"** by Mira Sol with geometric orbit accents, page progress (*184 of 312* / *59%* orange progress bar), and a solid black pill CTA button (*"Continue"*).
- **Daily Goal Widget:** Compact timer progress ring displaying *22 / 30 min* (73%) with status message.
- **Up Next:** Horizontal scroll showcase featuring typographic covers for **"Salt & Signal"**, **"The Long Noon"**, and **"Paper Tigers"** with tiny `#F5C518` rating stars.
- **Bottom Navigation:** Fixed 390px bottom bar with line icons for *Home* (active in orange), *Search*, *Shelf*, and *Profile*.

outputComponents.suggestion: Design the 'Shelf' library screen in light mode
Design the reading timer / session screen for 'Quiet Orbit'
Create the book detail view with reading statistics

screens.name: projects/11272431921498675969/screens/c5a1d0a3cbea40808e3b6689f323ec91
screens.prompt:
Create a mobile screen (390px width) for 'Folio', a minimal monochrome book reading tracker for students in LIGHT MODE.

Design specification & visual styling:
- Palette: Background off-white #F5F4F0, cards & containers white #FFFFFF with subtle 1px border #E7E5DF, ink near-black #141414, muted grey #8A8A8A, ONE vibrant accent orange #E8742A. Tiny yellow #F5C518 star for rating.
- Typography: Clean geometric sans font, heavy 800 weight for main titles, crisp small regular body text, uppercase tracking-wider micro-labels.
- Aesthetics: Fully rounded pill buttons and chips, book covers with 10px corner radius, hairline borders (#E7E5DF), strictly flat aesthetic with no heavy drop shadows and no gradients. Flat graphic typographic covers with solid colors (black, off-white, orange, grey) and bold geometric forms.

Screen details — BOOK DETAIL for 'Salt & Signal' by Dev Rao:
1. Top Navigation Bar: Minimalist top bar with back arrow button (chevron_left or arrow_back) on the left, and a bookmark save icon button on the right (alongside an optional share or overflow action).
2. Graphic Typographic Cover (Hero): Centered prominent graphic book cover (10px rounded corners, approx 160px wide by 230px tall, clean 1px border) with bold graphic design: solid deep black/near-black #141414 background with bold geometric orange #E8742A horizontal wave/signal lines or geometric bar abstractions, large bold uppercase typography 'SALT & SIGNAL', 'DEV RAO'.
3. Book Title & Author: Large title 'Salt & Signal' in heavy 800 black font, followed by author 'Dev Rao' in #8A8A8A grey.
4. Stats Row / Badges: Clean horizontal row of stats cards or pills:
   - Rating: '4.6' with a tiny #F5C518 yellow star
   - Pages: '286 pages'
   - Genre: 'Sci-Fi' tag/pill
   - Reading Time: '7h read'
5. Quick Actions Row: Outlined pill button with plus icon '+ Add to shelf' (white bg, 1px #E7E5DF border, black text/icon, rounded-full) next to a circular or rounded icon button for 'Share'.
6. 'About the book' section: Section title in uppercase or bold font, followed by a concise, evocative paragraph describing the novel in crisp small regular text (#141414 / #8A8A8A).
7. 'Readers also liked' section: Section heading with a row of 3 small graphic covers (10px radius, flat typography and shapes):
   - 'The Long Noon' by Ana Kade (cream/orange geometric half-sun)
   - 'Paper Tigers' by Leo Marsh (black with minimal geometric overlapping squares)
   - 'Quiet Orbit' by Mira Sol (dark with orange sphere/orbit arc)
   Include title and author below each thumbnail.
8. Bottom Fixed Action Area:
   - Full-width black (#141414) pill CTA button: 'Continue reading · p. 92' with a small forward play/arrow icon, white text.
   - Standard 4-tab bottom navigation bar (Home, Search, Shelf, Profile) with hairline top border, active item highlighted in orange #E8742A. Ensure proper bottom padding so the CTA floats comfortably above the bottom navigation.
screens.title: Folio - Book Detail

outputComponents.text:
I have created the **Book Detail** screen for *'Salt & Signal'* by Dev Rao in light mode, designed strictly according to Folio's design system:

### Key Highlights:
- **Palette & Typography:** Rendered with the warm off-white background (`#F5F4F0`), clean card borders (`#E7E5DF`), deep near-black typography (`#141414`), muted secondary copy (`#8A8A8A`), and signature orange (`#E8742A`) accents.
- **Graphic Typographic Book Cover:** Centered minimal geometric cover art featuring high-contrast typographic titling and stylized signal lines.
- **Key Metrics & Metadata:** Segmented stat pills showcasing the **4.6★** rating (with a delicate `#F5C518` yellow star), 286 pages, Sci-Fi genre badge, and estimated 7-hour read pace.
- **Contextual Actions & Progress:** Outlined pill button for `+ Add to shelf` paired with quick share and audio controls, a current reading streak tracker, and an engaging "About the book" synopsis.
- **Related Recommendations & Sticky CTA:** A "Readers also liked" carousel featuring typographic covers for *The Long Noon*, *Paper Tigers*, and *Quiet Orbit*, anchored by the docked near-black pill CTA: **"Continue reading · p. 92"**.

screens.name: projects/11272431921498675969/screens/ced915ac2e81405b8e0d776aa34a94a4
screens.prompt:
Design the Profile / Stats screen for "Folio", a minimal book reading tracker for students in LIGHT MODE.

Target device: mobile (390px width).
Design System & Palette:
- Background: off-white #F5F4F0
- Cards & tiles: clean crisp white #FFFFFF with 1px solid #E7E5DF hairline border, 10px rounded corners (rounded-[10px]). Flat, no heavy shadows, no gradients.
- Typography: Ink near-black #141414, secondary/subtitles muted grey #8A8A8A. Geometric sans font with heavy font-extrabold (weight 800) titles, small regular body text.
- Accent: ONE bold accent orange #E8742A. Tiny yellow #F5C518 star only for ratings.
- Buttons & chips: fully rounded pill shapes (rounded-full).
- Bottom nav: 4 line icons (Home, Search, Shelf, Profile) with Profile actively highlighted in orange #E8742A.

Screen structure and exact content:
1. Top bar: minimal header with screen title or Folio brand styling and an edit / settings action icon.
2. Centered Profile Header:
   - Centered circular avatar with initials 'RK' (near-black ink #141414 background with off-white text, or subtle light border).
   - Name: 'Riya Kapoor' in heavy 800 font.
   - Handle: '@riya.reads' in #8A8A8A.
   - Small pill chips: 'Following 128' and 'Followers 96' in light subtle pill styling.
3. Reading Stats (2x2 grid, 10px border radius tiles):
   - 'Books read': 24
   - 'Pages': 6,480
   - 'Hours': 112
   - 'Longest streak': 31 days -> make this specific tile bold accent orange background (#E8742A) with crisp white/ink text as specified.
4. 'My shelf' section:
   - Section header 'My shelf' (heavy 800) with a 'See all' link on the right.
   - Horizontal row / carousel of 4 small graphic typographic book covers (10px border radius, flat geometric graphic design with solid colours from black #141414, off-white #F5F4F0, orange #E8742A, grey #8A8A8A, bold typography):
     * 'Quiet Orbit' by Mira Sol
     * 'Salt & Signal' by Dev Rao
     * 'The Long Noon' by Ana Kade
     * 'Paper Tigers' by Leo Marsh
   - No photos, clean flat typographic covers matching Folio aesthetic.
5. 'Favourite genres' section:
   - Fully rounded chips (rounded-full):
     * 'Sci-Fi' (active black #141414 background, white text)
     * 'Fantasy'
     * 'Self-help'
     * 'Poetry'
     * 'History'
     * 'Design'
6. 'This year' Reading Activity:
   - Section header 'This year' with annual total summary.
   - Clean minimal bar chart showing books read per month (Jan to Dec or last 6-12 months). The current month bar is highlighted in bold accent orange #E8742A, while other months are subtle light grey or dark ink bars, with month labels underneath.
7. Docked Bottom Navigation Bar:
   - Fixed at bottom: Home, Search, Shelf, Profile.
   - Profile tab is active with orange #E8742A icon and label.
screens.title: Folio - Profile & Stats

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Folio Profile & Stats** screen in light mode, designed strictly around your specifications and the established design system:

### Visual & Structural Design Decisions:
- **Palette & Finish**: Pure off-white background (`#F5F4F0`) with crisp white card containers (`#FFFFFF`), delicate `1px #E7E5DF` hairline borders, and zero heavy shadows or gradients.
- **Identity & Header**: Centered circular avatar displaying the `'RK'` monogram, bold 800 weight typography for `'Riya Kapoor'`, subtle `@riya.reads` handle, and paired pill chips for `'Following 128'` and `'Followers 96'`.
- **2×2 Stats Grid**: 10px rounded tiles showcasing `'Books read: 24'`, `'Pages: 6,480'`, `'Hours: 112'`, with the `'Longest streak: 31 days'` tile styled in the signature vibrant orange (`#E8742A`).
- **My Shelf**: Horizontal lineup of four flat typographic graphic covers (*Quiet Orbit*, *Salt & Signal*, *The Long Noon*, and *Paper Tigers*) utilizing strict geometric compositions and 10px rounded corners.
- **Favourite Genres**: Full-pill interactive filter chips featuring `'Sci-Fi'` actively selected in near-black ink, alongside Fantasy, Self-help, Poetry, History, and Design.
- **Activity & Velocity ('This year')**: Minimal month-by-month reading velocity bar chart with the active month prominently accentuated in orange.
- **Docked Navigation**: 4-item bottom navigation bar with the **Profile** destination highlighted in bold orange.

Design the expanded 'My Shelf' grid view screen

screens.prompt:
Create a mobile Reader View screen for "Folio", a minimal book reading tracker for students in Light mode.

Design details strictly following user requirements and Folio Light design system:
- Background: off-white #F5F4F0.
- Ink / Text: near-black #141414, secondary text muted grey #8A8A8A, ONE accent orange #E8742A.
- Cards/containers: white #FFFFFF with hairline 1px border #E7E5DF, no heavy shadows.
- Typography: Clean sans-serif, bold 800 headers, small regular body text.
- Top bar: Minimal header with back arrow button, centered title 'Chapter 7 · The Long Noon' (with subtle book author 'Ana Kade' or chapter subtitle), and an 'Aa' font settings button.
- Reading Area: Clean, large comfortable reading text paragraphs (serif-free sans-serif, 17px, line-height 1.6 or leading-relaxed), ample margin padding. Include compelling sci-fi literary text for 'The Long Noon'.
- Highlighted text: Exactly ONE highlighted sentence in pale translucent orange background (e.g. bg-[#E8742A]/15 border-l-2 border-[#E8742A] or inline highlight text) with an interactive feeling annotation badge or comment icon.
- Reading scrubber / bottom panel:
  - Thin accent orange progress bar indicating progress through the book/chapter.
  - Metadata row: 'p. 143 / 260 · 18 min left in chapter' in clean muted typography.
  - Reader quick controls: fully rounded pill buttons / control bar containing font size adjustment 'A-' and 'A+', brightness / line-spacing icon, and a theme toggle pill (Light / Dark / Sepia or quick light switch).
  - Bottom navigation bar: 4 line icons (Home, Search, Shelf, Profile) with Shelf or Home active in orange #E8742A, docked cleanly.
- Strict design discipline: No photos, flat typographic geometric aesthetic, rounded pill chips, 10px radius elements where applicable. High contrast, refined editorial typography.
screens.title: Folio - Reader View

outputComponents.text:
I've designed the **Folio Reader View** in Light Mode adhering precisely to the Folio design system and your specifications:

- **Header**: Minimal top bar featuring a back navigation button, bookmark toggle, book title and chapter header (`Chapter 7 · The Long Noon`), and an **Aa** typography settings action.
- **Reading Typography**: Comfortable sans-serif reading experience set at 17px with 1.6 line height on warm off-white (`#F5F4F0`) for optimal student reading endurance.
- **Highlighted Passage**: Features a highlighted sentence accented in soft translucent orange with an attached student margin note badge (`Student Note: Existential anchor point for Ch. 8`).
- **Reading Scrubber & Controls**: Docked floating reader toolbar displaying the progress bar in signature orange (`#E8742A`), page count & remaining time estimate (`p. 143 / 260 · 18 min left in chapter`), quick font sizing controls (`A-` / `A+`), formatting controls, and a theme switcher (`Light`, `Sepia`, `Dark`).
- **Navigation**: Persistent bottom bar with line icons for Home, Search, Shelf (active orange), and Profile.
